title: gisekia miltus
intro: Gisekia miltus, commonly known as the false dandelion or wild cotton, is a plant species native to tropical Asia. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gisekia miltus include treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as skin conditions like eczema and dermatitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
